description: This file defines the BulkImportEvent class, which extends FineractEvent and encapsulates data related to a bulk import event, including a workbook, import ID, locale, and date format.

classes.name: BulkImportEvent
classes.description: Final class representing a bulk import event, carrying details such as a workbook, import ID, locale, and date format, and extending FineractEvent.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of BulkImportEvent with provided source, workbook, import ID, locale, date format, and context.

methods.name: getWorkbook
methods.description: Returns the workbook associated with the bulk import event.

methods.name: getImportId
methods.description: Returns the import ID associated with the event.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Returns the date format string for the event.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale string for the event.
